snippet.title: Don't Stop The Pop! - Totally Accurate Popcorn Making Sim - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Ready to turn a single kernel into an unstoppable popcorn machine? Build your strategy with a massive Skill Tree; discover dozens of flavors from salty to chocolatey, spicy to salted caramel, and fill the screen with pops! Earn more, pop more! Don't Stop the Pop! 🍿

Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4608670/Dont_Stop_The_Pop/
